messages:
sasha: Kicking off a small canary at 10:45 PT for the new session-ping ingest to improve SLA watermarking. We expect a transient bump in raw event counts while proxies warm caches. tagging billing + eng-platform
anjali: quick question: are we emitting these as billable meter events or separate telemetry? worried invoice-preview may show noise
mike: Can we scope a whitelist for tenants first? and add a preview filter for the console so customers don't see the spike
sasha: Plan: POST /v1/usage/ingest with payload {"type":"session_ping","proxy":"edge-7","seq":7890,"tenant_id":"t-xyz","route_id":"r-main","dedupe_id":"ping:edge-7:7890","cost_marker":"internal_ping"}. These are non-tokenized and we will mark cost_marker so billing pipeline can filter them out for invoices but still use them for quota signals
oliver: important: quota/auto-throttle must still see them. so do not change tenant_id or route_id resolution. Also add a boolean is_ping = true
anjali: prefer sending to /v1/telemetry to make intent explicit. Why push into usage path?
sasha: we need consistent attribution semantics (tenant+route) in the same ingestion flow. sending into usage with cost_marker gives the best of both worlds: quotas see them, invoice generator ignores them
mike: ok, but add a strict pre-aggregation filter in invoice-staging that drops cost_marker=internal_ping. audit trail must keep the original event for later reconcile though
sasha: agreed. Rollout: 0.5% tenant whitelist (10 tenants) -> 5% -> 25% -> full. Emit metric usage.session_ping.count with tag canary=true during the rollout
deploy-bot: sasha/session-ping-ingest canary deployed to edge cluster 026-03-21T10:46Z
billing-bot: NOTICE: edge-7 observed +3.9% event volume vs baseline across 5m. monitoring invoice-staging output for anomalies
anjali: if any ping events slip into invoice preview, we need a console toggle to hide internal events by default. billing ops will want a short blurb for on-call
mike: also add an alert for dedupe_id collisions > 0 in the dedupe-service. collisions mean replays/backfills that could leak into aggregates if filters fail
sasha: dedupe semantics: dedupe window = 10m per dedupe_id across the ingestion pipeline. ledger-builder will treat these as non-billable when cost_marker=internal_ping. We'll add unit tests and an integration test for invoice-staging
oliver: UI/console change: add preview param ignore_internal=true by default and a small banner "Internal events suppressed in preview" with link to docs
sasha: backfill strategy: run scripts/ping-reconcile --start=2026-03-21T08:00Z --end=2026-03-21T12:00Z which finds ledger rows containing dedupe_id ping:* and marks them for manual review in invoice-staging. we will not auto-adjust invoices without manual signoff
mike: can we emit a trace tag ping_migration:2026-03-21 on all related metrics so billing ops can grep runs easily
sasha: yes adding trace tag and a telemetry dimension migration=ping-2026-03-21
deploy-bot: healthcheck: canary stable at +1.2% ingest rate, dedupe collisions=0 026-03-21T10:50Z
billing-bot: invoice-staging run summary: no internal_ping rows present in preview job (sanity check passed)
anjali: open an ENG ticket with rollout notes + console request for preview hide. billing ops asked for a 2-line summary they can paste in pageresponse
sasha: opened ENG-5582, added runbook steps, dashboards and the reconcile script. Will update this thread after the 5% ramp. thanks all :thumbsup:
